diagnosis.root_cause: When _separable recursively evaluates a nested CompoundModel, its children become dependency matrices. For a right-hand matrix, _cstack replaces the entire dependency block with ones instead of preserving its contents. This turns independent linear-model inputs into false dependencies.
diagnosis.suggested_fix: Copy the right-hand dependency matrix into its block, matching the left-hand handling. Add a regression comparing nested and unnested parallel models.
limitations: Baseline tests and runtime reproduction were not run.
The proposed patch has not been applied or validated.

diagnosis.root_cause: When lastmod is callable and items() is empty, Sitemap.get_latest_lastmod() calls max([]), which raises ValueError. Only TypeError is caught, so the exception propagates through the sitemap index view.
diagnosis.suggested_fix: Catch ValueError alongside TypeError, returning None for empty sitemaps. Add a regression test asserting an empty sitemap with callable lastmod produces a successful index response without <lastmod> or a Last-Modified header.
limitations: No baseline tests or reproduction were run.
The proposed patch is UNVERIFIED and has not been applied.

diagnosis.root_cause: The TrueType branch of RendererPS.draw_text unconditionally appends curr_stream after glyph layout. An empty line yields no glyphs, so curr_stream remains None and stream becomes [None]. Unpacking that entry raises the reported TypeError. Text.draw forwards empty lines to the renderer.
diagnosis.suggested_fix: Append the final glyph stream only when it exists, matching the existing guard inside the loop. Add regression coverage saving annotations and titles with leading, interior, and trailing empty lines to PS and EPS.
diagnosis.proposed_patch:
--- a/lib/matplotlib/backends/backend_ps.py
+++ b/lib/matplotlib/backends/backend_ps.py
@@ -669,5 +669,6 @@
             # append the last entry
-            stream.append(curr_stream)
+            if curr_stream:
+                stream.append(curr_stream)
 
         self.set_color(*gc.get_rgb())
